race.comment: Big field and wide open. TALISAY (16) found the line strongly fresh over 1250m on the Parks track then closed from the back over 1550m here last time. Looks to be crying out for this journey and well placed with the claim. Looks ready to fire. WEATHER DELAY (6) found winning form last time on the synthetic at Ballarat. Going well and looks up to this grade. REGAL RIPPER (5) was a winner here two back then not far away here last time. Tricky gate but extra trip looks a plus and should be hard to hold out. TOTTORI (9) was slow to begin and gave a start but was too good at the provincials last time. Deserves a chance back here now. Many of these come through the MR TRAFFICANTI race including the winner. GLOUF (11) was well off best in said race but has the blinkers added this time and can improve sharply.
